    Prepare data blocks for post-SCM estimation (generalized mscPost)

    prepare_data_general.Rd

    Build stacked outcome/design matrices and weights for downstream estimation. Accepts a canonical weights matrix with rownames=unit ids and colnames=treated ids.

    prepare_data_general(
  dta,
  W = NULL,
  res = NULL,
  y_name,
  f.X,
  f.Z = NULL,
  id_col = "id",
  time_col = "wID",
  tr_col = "tvg.dummy",
  treat_type = c("binary", "continuous"),
  second_stage = c("none", "moderators", "moderators_iv"),
  first_stage = c("none", "selection_probit", "treat_iv"),
  treat_threshold = 0,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    dta

    data.table panel containing id/time/treatment and covariates.

    W

    weights matrix (rownames unit ids, colnames treated ids) OR NULL if res provided.

    res

    optional fit object (e.g., multisynth, augMultiSynth-like) used to build W.

    y_name

    outcome column in dta.

    f.X

    formula for the per-observation design matrix (must include treatment column if desired).

    f.Z

    optional moderators formula (treated-unit level) for second stage.

    id_col

    unit id column name.

    time_col

    time column name.

    tr_col

    treatment column name (can be binary or continuous).

    treat_type

    "binary" or "continuous".

    second_stage

    "none","moderators","moderators_iv".

    first_stage

    "none","selection_probit","treat_iv".

    treat_threshold

    threshold for continuous treated definition when inferring treated set.

    verbose

    logical.

    Value

    list with Y_block, X_block, W, Z_block (optional), instruments (optional), and metadata.
